requestedEndpoints.purpose: Desktop local proxy for the Developer public API and bounded build services
Read-only chain status, RPC, compiler metadata, and signed deploy relay; no browser RPC probe is a wallet-connect prerequisite

consumerProposal.bundleOnly: The desktop app may consume only an accepted immutable manifest bundled with the exact artifact.
consumerProposal.transport: Native desktop proxy only; no renderer direct fetch and no wallet connection preflight RPC probe.
consumerProposal.failureMode: Keep desktop network=false, preserve local IDE and Standard Wallet state, and surface NETWORK_MANIFEST_UNAVAILABLE without retrying an unapproved endpoint.
evidenceRequiredBeforeEnablement: installed macOS and Windows HTTPS proof

notRequested: wallet-auth origin: Product Session remains controlled by the accepted root factory and is not enabled by this desktop network candidate
third-party model-provider origins: model routing remains server-side and is not a desktop endpoint request
